notes.title: PSYCHODEATH 狂死 IS HERE.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello HOWLING VOID [空],[/h1]
[h2]PYSCHODEATH 狂死 is here.  You will notice new stages, improved enemies, and more options for combat. Projectiles have been completely reworked. The game has been made easier for beginners but more in depth for old players. [/h2]
[h1]Enjoy,
STS[/h1]

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new Slow Reload mechanic has been introduced as an alternative to ammo catching.
[*] Ammo drops have been made larger and yield two bullets instead of one.
[*] New hit and death visuals have been added.
[*] Ammo drops have been given an improved icon. [+]
[*] Projectiles have been optimized and given better visual effects.
[*] There are new bullet types in the game.
[*] The default rifle now fires atomic bullets.
[*] The Attraction Beam now fires plasma shots.
[*] Purple Viroids now fire atomic bullets.
[*] Bloody Spinners now emit a trail of blood bullets.
[*] Ranchy Spinners now fire bursts of atomic bullets.
[*] Skybrooders now emit plasma bursts and atomic bullets in an alternating pattern.
[*] Z Sword has been given new and much larger hitboxes.
[*] Z Sword and Commet Hammer movement jank has been debugged.
[/list]

[h2]Level changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Remixes are now available to all, Mac and Windows, DLC or not. Those who purchases the extra DLC pack have been given a special reward :)
[*] The Planetarium has a more balanced viroid pool.
[*] Z Chess has a more balanced viroid pool.
[*] Z Chess has been visually reworked.
[/list]

[h2]UI:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The inaccurate max level indicator glitch has been fixed.
[*] Remix menu is easier to return to after a defeat.
[/list]

[h2]Other:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Universal framerate has been locked to 60 FPS regardless of device.
[*] A secret level has been added.
[/list]

notes.title: INCOMING UPDATE: PSYCHODEATH狂死
notes.content:
[h1]Hello SPIRITS IN THE SCREEN [霊],[/h1]
After meditating upon a mountaintop for many moons, my eyes shot open, and I reached a grand realization: this game has so much more potential, so much more to give.
And not only that, but you, the players and fans, the ones who bother to read this and/or give feedback, deserve to have your voices heard, and not just heard, but acted upon. 
[h1]I am working on an update, one of many, that will make the game a more full, pleasant experience.[/h1]
[h2][list]
[*] In this coming update, there will be more levels, available to all, that will make the gameplay much longer. 
[*] In this coming update, there will be new mechanics, that will allow for more ways to fight and win.
[*] In this coming update, there will be many under-the-hood optimizations that will make gameplay smoother on more devices.
[/list][/h2]
[h1]Stay tuned,
STS[/h1]

notes.title: MAC IS BACK!
notes.content:
[h1]PH0B0S is once again compatible with OSX![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42579514/9d190d2b1d262fb3ee4e39a2b87a873cfa23197d.gif[/img]
[h2]Grab your hundred dollar pencil and excessively aerodynamic bluetooth mouse (god forbid you try playing on trackpad), PH0B0S can now be experienced by Apple users.[/h2]

[h1]In addition to this, many tweaks have been made:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The UI has been made more clean and readable
[*] Enemies now take knockback from projectiles and weapons
[*] Orbit stage has been reworked
[*] The Starhooks' hitboxes have been tweaked for better use when scaling walls or vaulting
[/list]

notes.title: The Final Frontier
notes.content:
[h1]L0VE, ALL YOU NEED IS L0VE. [/h1]
[i]But this isn't love. Real love can't be bought, nor can it be sold. Sorry, it's true. You will not find love browsing a digital game store.
But can you trust me when I say that I made this with love? That I love making games and I love anyone who bothers to play them? It's true. 
I am not a salesperson, trying to make a pitch. This is not an advertisement. It's just a "thank you" note, a love letter of sorts, to you. Thank you for taking interest in my game. 
[/i]
[h1]WHAT IS L0VE?[/h1]
[h2][b]Levels redesigned, remodeled, and retextured from scratch.[/b][/h2]
[i]Baby don't hurt me, don't hurt me, no more.[/i]
[h2][b]Weapons redesigned, remodeled, and retextured from scratch.[/b][/h2]
[i]Baby don't hurt me, don't hurt me, no more.[/i]
[h2][b]New trippy (and very seizure inducing, seriously don't play this if you have epilepsy) and stunning visual effects across the board.[/b][/h2]
[h1][i]L0VE is not a game, it is art you can play.[/i][/h1]
[i]The visuals are the best part of PH0B0S by far. It's pretty simple otherwise.[/i]

[h1]Levels:[/h1]
[h3][i][list]
[*] PLANETARIUM: a vaporwave inspired vision of paradise.
[*] CHESS: a corrupted acid trip of spasming walls and optically confounding game pieces.
[*] ORBIT: blotches of ink rain from a crack in the sky.
[*] MINOTAUR: [redacted] [no literally]
[*] MONUMENT: a shimmering statue surrounded by swirling sands and shining sunbeams that stab at stygian shadow.
[*] SKYTOWER: the most retro and absurd of all, the essence of PH0B0S, beyond description.
[/list][/i][/h3]

[h1]Weapons:[/h1]
[h3][i][list]
[*] </3 RIFLE: Break some hearts and all that, just don't run out of ammo!
[*] STARHOOK: The magical girl's weapon of choice, complete with star and heart "particles". There are no actual particles in PH0B0S. Ever notice that?
[*] ZSWORD:  A flowery rapier of, truth be told, subpar utility. Points for style, right?
[*] ATTRACTION BEAM: Basically just an upgrade to the rifle. Love is war.
[*] COMMET HAMMER: The funniest weapon of them all, rocket towards either certain victory or certain death! And now it's PURPLE!
[/list][/i][/h3]
